Filmed about 4 decades before there would be such a thing as "creepy pasta" stories and a story like this would make great "creepy pasta" there was a story on the science fiction tv show BATTLESTAR GALACTICA that was basically HORROR and I was surprised that a tv show meant for children and filmed in 1978 would allow something this scary (nightmare fuel).

The main characters were on a planet ruled by a race of insectoid creatures called OVIONS who ran casinos, basically the science fiction version of Las Vegas.  The human characters were absolutely thrilled because the casinos were basically the exact opposite of real life casinos.  They were rigged to enable the players to WIN and WIN BIG.  Everyone was filled with joy as they were winning constantly at the gambling games and all getting rich very quickly.

However, the seemingly ONLY two characters with any common sense and intelligence, Starbuck and Apollo, had a bad feeling.  They knew that if something seemed too good to be true it probably was.  They did some careful investigating and discovered to their horror that the Ovions were rigging the gambling machines to let the players win big to keep them there and to keep them happy.  Their plan was to HARVEST THEM FOR FOOD.  Starbuck and Apollo found several human bodies in cold storage but of course when he tried to warn the sheeple nobody would listen to them.  

The only reason they did not end up becoming food for the Ovions (I never found out whether or not they got to keep the money that they won, the story never really told us) was that the Cylons (evil robots that wanted to exterminate humanity) showed up and they were forced to flee from that danger.  Ironically, by forcing them to flee the Cylons effectively SAVED their lives.

Basically ANY story where a person or group are winning big in casinos there will be a dark twist.
